postgres_transaction: real Drizzle SQL transaction; recorded QB resolution occurs after its commit
pglite_transaction: pinned queryBuilder.transaction invokes callback(db) with retries and does not begin an SQL transaction
event_label_correction: The historical order.json event named transaction_committed records the QB transaction Promise resolving. It is not a claim of an SQL COMMIT for PGlite.
finding: On both actual backends the second range fetch completes before prior QB completion, then second block-data phase starts after prior QB completion. No rollback behavior was tested by this probe.
